origins.section: 1.1. A Message Is an MTI, a Bitmap and the Fields the Bitmap Announces
1.2. The Standard Fixes What a Field Means, and Each Link Fixes Its Bytes
1.3. The First MTI Digit Names the Edition, and Editions Disagree on Fields
1.4. jPOS Is AGPL: Network Users of Your Modified Version Are Offered Its Source

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-terminal-monitor: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-terminal-monitor: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-terminal-monitor: Section 1.1 says only the fields whose bits are set follow, in field-number order, and no field has a fixed position; adding field 22 moved field 41 from offset 72 to 75, so a fixed-offset reader reads the wrong place.
recorded.prompt:q-second-processor: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-second-processor: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-second-processor: Section 1.2 shows two 1987 packagers, ASCII and BCD, unable to read each other's message, and says the standard fixes meaning while each network's dialect fixes the encoding.
recorded.prompt:q-issuer-upgrade: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-issuer-upgrade: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-issuer-upgrade: Section 1.3: 000 in field 39 is a 1993 approval and "00".equals(field 39) printed false, so the client reports a decline while the issuer has approved and holds the funds.
recorded.prompt:q-switch-licence: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-switch-licence: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-switch-licence: Section 1.4: if you modify the program and users interact with your version over a network, you must offer them its source, and the connecting systems may be such users.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-terminal-monitor:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-terminal-monitor:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-terminal-monitor:a: 1.1 says a reader has to read the bitmap and walk every field before the one it wants, and a fixed-position script does neither.
recorded.prompt:q-terminal-monitor:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-terminal-monitor:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-terminal-monitor:b: 1.1 states outright that no field has a fixed position.
recorded.prompt:q-terminal-monitor:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-terminal-monitor:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-terminal-monitor:d: 1.1's breakdown puts the bitmap right after the MTI, and in the field-22 example the bitmap's value changes while field 41 is what moves.
recorded.prompt:q-second-processor:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-second-processor:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-second-processor:a: 1.2: two 1987 packagers cannot read each other's messages, so a shared edition is not enough.
recorded.prompt:q-second-processor:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-second-processor:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-second-processor:b: 1.1 says the bitmap says which fields are present, and 1.2 says the dialect fixes the encoding.
recorded.prompt:q-second-processor:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-second-processor:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-second-processor:d: 1.2 names ASCII among the encodings a dialect may choose, and 1.7 lists iso87ascii.xml as a 1987 packager.
recorded.prompt:q-issuer-upgrade:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-issuer-upgrade:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-issuer-upgrade:b: 1.3 says the issuer has approved and holds the funds.
recorded.prompt:q-issuer-upgrade:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-issuer-upgrade:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-issuer-upgrade:c: 1.3's output shows "00".equals(field 39): false for a 000 response.
recorded.prompt:q-issuer-upgrade:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-issuer-upgrade:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-issuer-upgrade:d: 1.3's output reads field 39 as 000 under the 1993 definitions, and the equality check fails.
recorded.prompt:q-switch-licence:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-switch-licence:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-switch-licence:a: 1.4 says the distribution trigger belongs to the plain GPL, and the AGPL adds an obligation without distribution.
recorded.prompt:q-switch-licence:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-switch-licence:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-switch-licence:b: 1.4's own processor patches a single channel class and still raises the obligation, because the trigger is the modification.
recorded.prompt:q-switch-licence:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-switch-licence:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-switch-licence:d: 1.4 says the trigger is the modification, not whether the service is paid, and unmodified jPOS carries no such offer.

gates.says: each of the 4 questions keys exactly 1 of its distinct options and every option carries the sentence its reader is shown
each of the 4 questions cites a passage the ledger still digests to the value this exercise was built from
